_about: Your picks for the home page ticker. Add one line per game under "picks", keyed by team and game date in Boston time, for example "bruins 2026-10-24": "BOS -1.5". Teams: patriots, celtics, redsox, bruins, bc-football, bc-hoops, psu-football, psu-hoops. A pick can be a spread ("BOS -1.5", "NE +3"), a moneyline ("BOS ML" or "BOS -142"), or a total ("O 50.5", "U 6.5"); team codes are the ones on the ticker. When the game ends the ticker marks it with a check, an X or Push. This file is public, like everything else on the site: picks, not dollar amounts.
